title: Bonus Tent
description: Replaces the vanilla bonus chest with a cozy, well-stocked survival tent with smart flat-ground spawning!
body:
# 🏕️ Bonus Tent (Fabric 1.16.5)

Tired of the same old boring bonus chest sitting on the ground when you start a new world? **Bonus Tent** completely revamps your early-game start! 

This mod replaces the standard vanilla bonus chest with a cozy, abandoned explorer's tent. 

### ✨ Key Features:
* **Smart Spawning Algorithm:** The mod scans the starting chunk to find a perfect $5 \times 5$ flat clearing. No more structures floating in the air or cutting into tree leaves!
* **Upgraded Survival Loot:** The chest is packed with actual starting gear (stone tools, plenty of food, torches, and wood logs) with a 35% chance to find a rare Easter-egg diamond!
* **Scavenger's Barrel:** A nearby barrel filled with camping scraps like sticks, strings, bones, and dirt blocks.
* **Atmospheric Campfire:** A campfire sits right outside the tent, shooting a column of bright particles into the sky so you can easily spot your camp from a distance.
* **No Junk Left Behind:** All technical structure blocks are completely removed during generation.

---
Developed by **David Lite Studio**. Enjoy your new adventure!
